templates.name: City youth grant (example): reach and attendance

period.meaning: The reporting period, written out, for example "July to September 2026".

participants_served.meaning: Participants who attended at least one session in the period.

new_participants.meaning: Participants whose join date falls inside the period.

sessions_delivered.meaning: Group sessions that ran in the period.

participant_hours.meaning: Total hours participants spent in sessions they attended (each session counted at its length).

attendance_rate.meaning: Share of seats filled at sessions with attendance logged. Each enrolled group member is one seat at each of those sessions. Sessions that ran without attendance logged are left out.

g1_value.meaning: New participants enrolled since the goal started (goal: "Enroll 8 new participants").

g1_target.meaning: Target for the new participants goal.

g2_value.meaning: Participant hours since the goal started (goal: "Participant hours").

g2_target.meaning: Target for the participant hours goal.

period.meaning: The reporting period, written out, for example "July to September 2026".

retention_rate.meaning: Participants still enrolled on the last day of the period, as a share of everyone enrolled at any point in it.

attendance_rate.meaning: Share of seats filled at sessions with attendance logged. Each enrolled group member is one seat at each of those sessions.

assignment_submissions.meaning: Assignments handed in during the period.

submissions_per_participant.meaning: Assignments handed in per participant served.

participants_served.meaning: Participants who attended at least one session in the period.

g2_value.meaning: Participant hours since the goal started (goal: "Participant hours").

g2_target.meaning: Target for the participant hours goal.

g3_value.meaning: Assignment submissions since the goal started (goal: "Assignment submissions").

g3_target.meaning: Target for the assignment submissions goal.

g4_value.meaning: Attendance rate since the goal started (goal: "Attendance rate of 80%").

g4_target.meaning: Target for the attendance rate goal.
